## Exercise 1: Publication Theme

### 1.1 Create a Custom Theme

```{r}
theme_pub <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.border = element_rect(fill = NA, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
```

### 1.2 Apply the Theme

```{r}
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, color = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Fuel Efficiency vs Vehicle Weight",
    x = "Weight (1000 lbs)",
    y = "Miles per Gallon",
    color = "Cylinders"
  ) +
  theme_pub()
```

## Exercise 2: Colorblind-Friendly Colors

```{r}
okabe_ito <- c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#009E73", "#F0E442",
               "#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#CC79A7", "#999999")

ggplot(iris, aes(x = Species, y = Sepal.Length, fill = Species)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = okabe_ito[1:3]) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Exercise 3: Multi-Panel Figures

### 3.1 Create Component Plots

```{r}
p1 <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(wt, mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Weight vs MPG") +
  theme_classic()

p2 <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(factor(cyl), mpg)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "MPG by Cylinders", x = "Cylinders") +
  theme_classic()

p3 <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(mpg)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 10, fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "MPG Distribution") +
  theme_classic()
```

### 3.2 Combine Side by Side

```{r}
p1 + p2
```

### 3.3 Stack Vertically

```{r}
p1 / p2
```

### 3.4 Complex Layout

```{r}
(p1 + p2) / p3
```

### 3.5 Add Panel Labels

```{r}
(p1 + p2) / p3 +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
```

## Exercise 4: Complete Figure

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

# Panel A
fig_a <- ggplot(iris, aes(x = Sepal.Length, y = Sepal.Width, color = Species)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(x = "Sepal Length (cm)", y = "Sepal Width (cm)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Panel B
fig_b <- ggplot(iris, aes(x = Petal.Length, y = Petal.Width, color = Species)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(x = "Petal Length (cm)", y = "Petal Width (cm)") +
  theme_classic()

# Panel C
fig_c <- ggplot(iris, aes(x = Species, y = Sepal.Length, fill = Species)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(y = "Sepal Length (cm)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Panel D
fig_d <- ggplot(iris, aes(x = Species, y = Petal.Length, fill = Species)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(y = "Petal Length (cm)") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Combine
(fig_a + fig_b) / (fig_c + fig_d) +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Iris Dataset: Morphological Measurements",
    tag_levels = "A"
  ) &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14))
```

## Bonus: Annotated Figure

```{r}
# Summary data
summary_data <- mtcars |>
  group_by(cyl) |>
  summarize(
    mean_mpg = mean(mpg),
    se = sd(mpg) / sqrt(n())
  )

# Bar plot with error bars and significance
ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = factor(cyl), y = mean_mpg, fill = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_mpg - se, ymax = mean_mpg + se), width = 0.2) +
  annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 3, y = 30, yend = 30) +
  annotate("text", x = 2, y = 31, label = "***", size = 5) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    title = "Mean MPG by Cylinder Count",
    x = "Cylinders",
    y = "Mean MPG (± SE)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
